title: Boston College Gabelli Presidential Scholars Program
program_type: Undergraduate academic merit scholarship with an honours programme and funded summer experience
duration: Are there activities for Scholars during the summer months?
description: The Gabelli Presidential Scholars Program is Boston College's premier undergraduate academic merit programme. Each year it awards full-tuition scholarships together with fully-funded, programme-sponsored summer programmes to 18 incoming freshmen. Scholars enrol in a University departmental honours programme and take part in summer experiences in service learning, international study and professional internships. There is no separate application: Early Decision and Regular Decision candidates who file their BC application by the November 1 priority scholarship deadline are considered.

title: Harvard College Need-Based Financial Aid (International Students)
program_type: Need-based undergraduate financial aid programme (not a merit scholarship)
duration: Four-year residential undergraduate program; aid is awarded for one academic year and re-applied for and re-awarded annually.
description: The Griffin Financial Aid Office at Harvard College provides need-based aid that allows Harvard to bring the best students regardless of their ability to pay. title: Princeton University Need-Based Financial Aid Program (International Students)
program_type: Need-based undergraduate financial aid programme (grant aid), not a merit scholarship
duration: Four years of English (including continued practice in writing).
description: Princeton University operates a strictly need-based financial aid programme that it applies identically to international and domestic students. The full need of every admitted international student is met with grant aid, and Princeton's admission process is need-blind, so applying for aid carries no admission disadvantage. Since 2001 Princeton has replaced student loans with grants in the aid package, so no student is required to borrow. Aid covers tuition, room, board and other assessed costs of attendance. program_type: Need-based undergraduate financial aid, international applicants

title: Dartmouth College Need-Based Financial Aid (International Students)
duration: Four-year bachelor's degree; aid is evaluated individually and annually
description: Dartmouth College meets 100% of the demonstrated need of all admitted financial aid applicants, regardless of citizenship or entry round, and its financial aid packages never include a required student loan. Need is calculated as cost of attendance minus family contribution, with direct expenses of tuition, fees, food and housing and indirect expenses such as travel, books, supplies and laundry. title: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme (AKF ISP) - Next Cycle, Opening Early 2027
official_source: Aga Khan Foundation (Aga Khan Development Network)
duration: Master's scholarships are granted for the entire duration of the degree course; PhD scholarships are awarded for the first two years

title: Rotary Peace Fellowship
program_type: Fully funded postgraduate fellowship in peace and development studies
duration: Master's programs last 15 to 24 months and include a two- to three-month field study designed by the participant. The professional development certificate program is one year of blended learning with 11 weeks of on-site participation (a two-week preliminary online course, a ten-week on-site course with field studies, a nine-month social change initiative with interactive online sessions, and a one-week on-site capstone seminar).
description: The Rotary Peace Fellowship is funded by The Rotary Foundation and awards up to 170 fellowships a year for leaders with work experience in peace and development to study at one of eight Rotary Peace Centers. Each year up to 50 fellowships fund master's degrees and up to 120 fund professional development certificate studies at partner universities. Fellowships cover tuition and fees, room and board, round-trip transportation, and internship and field-study expenses.
